reason: Ordinary capacity cleanup under Ivan's direct authorization: / was at 97% (376G/394G, 15G free). Reclaimed ~29.7 GiB by deleting only (a) sandbox-rerun media that is byte-identical to a copy surviving in the protected live tree, (b) regenerable pipeline intermediates with zero authority references, and (c) one re-downloadable external VOD. No JSON/SRT/ASS/receipt/log was deleted; no state write, no deploy, no lock taken.

method.n100_archive_finding: N100 /vol1/1000/Disk1/agent-archive holds ONLY Mac agent data (claude/codex/hermes/docs/novel/prediction.git/skillopt). No autoslice media copy exists there, so the 'N100 has a copy' precondition is unsatisfiable as literally written.
method.standard_applied_instead: The precedent already committed in cleanup_manifests/free_autoslice_enospc_recovery_cleanup_20260730.json: 'regenerable from retained source recordings' + zero references. Strengthened for batch 1 and batch 4b to a provable on-host byte-identical survivor.
method.reference_scan: Two-tier. Tier A (authority): state/, repo/assets, repo/profiles, repo/src, repo/scripts, repo/docs, cache/ (adjudication), forensics/, evals/, review_jobs/, review_packages/, upload_staging/, manual_review/, quarantine/, plus reports/ and recovery/ json|jsonl|md. Tier B (log-only): *.log and logs/ dirs, treated as historical records rather than resolvers. Tier A always protects; Tier-B-only references do not.
method.regenerability_check: CloudFS 123云盘 /root/clouddrive2/CloudNAS/CloudDrive/123云盘/live-streaming/22966160/<date>/ verified present and nonzero for every touched date before deletion.
method.quiet_window: DISABLED flag present throughout; runner.log confirmed 'DISABLED flag present — runner paused' each tick; zero ffmpeg/autoslice processes; runner.lock never touched.
